svg.aria-label: Two by two grid. Rows: attribution on the event (µw above the null models) or not on the event (µw at the level of the null models). Columns: according to the interventions, the decision uses the event or other characteristics of the video. Attribution and decision on the event: the event control. Attribution on the event, decision on other characteristics of the video: GRUMobileNet on SO-TAD, with µw 1.64 and a score of 94% of the original with the static background. Attribution not on the event, decision on the event: none of the evaluated models; this case would indicate a poorly estimated event region. Attribution not on the event, decision on other characteristics of the video: the video control and GRUMobileNet on TAD, with µw at the level of the null models and at least 90% of the score with the static background.
